verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Replit can schedule routines (replit-docs-49), but nothing documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. The reviewable background tasks applied to a 'main version' (replit-docs-39, replit-docs-48) cover Agent's code-change workflow, not automation versioning, and no rollback is described anywhere. That is adjacent at best, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
